resources.string: Use the AgentStack address reachable from this device and the token from its Brain share listener. Loopback (127.0.0.1) refers to this device, not your computer.
Settings could not be saved. Try again.
Connected. AgentStack is ready to receive shares.
Enter an http:// or https:// server URL.
Set the AgentStack server URL and token first.
Admitted to Brain (job %1$d). Indexing is pending.
Could not reach AgentStack. Is the tailnet up?
Could not reach AgentStack. Held to send later (waiting: %1$d).
Held until the server URL and token are set (waiting: %1$d).
The newest 20 links stay on this device. Removing one clears its local reminder only; it does not delete anything from AgentStack or cancel delivery.
Notifications are on. Each shared link stays available with Open and Remove actions.
Notifications are off. Recent links are still kept here.
Ongoing reminders for links shared with AgentStack
Held shares have no confirmed admission to Brain. They retry when the server answers. Changing servers keeps earlier shares bound to their original address.
Brain admitted %1$d of %2$d. Still waiting: %3$d. Not delivered: %4$d.
Shares for another server: %1$d. Restore its address in Settings to send them.
Nothing was waiting to be sent.
Discarded held shares: %1$d. Any unconfirmed server admission is unaffected.
Dropped because the outbox was full: %1$s

The outbox cannot be read. Delivery is paused and its file is unchanged. Back up and repair the app-private file %1$s with developer assistance, then reopen Settings and choose Send now. Do not clear app storage to fix this.
This share was not sent or held. Open AgentStack Settings to resolve the outbox problem, then share it again.
This share has no confirmed admission.
